name: godaddy-mcp
description: Manage the domains in your own GoDaddy account from Claude: list domains, edit DNS records, check availability, and register or renew domains. Community project, not affiliated with GoDaddy.

godaddy_pat.title: GoDaddy Personal Access Token
godaddy_pat.description: Create one at https://developer.godaddy.com/personal-access-token with the domains.domain:read, domains.dns:update, domains.domain:create and domains.nameserver:update scopes.

api_base_url.title: GoDaddy API
api_base_url.description: Production API, or GoDaddy's OTE test environment for trying things without real charges.
